ImageDescription.value: The KingPins Family Entertainment Center, on Jenkins Road near Cedar Hills Blvd. in Beaverton, Oregon. It opened in June 2018 and includes a bowling alley – replacing Sunset Lanes (a bowling alley that was located on an adjacent site and was in business from 1963 to 2018, but which closed in June 2018 and was torn down in early 2019) – as well as an arcade, laser-tag arena, and restaurant facilities.

ImageDescription.value: U.S. Space Force Spc. 4 Donovan Reynolds, U.S. Space Forces - Space laser deconfliction technician, executes a physical challenge during a Guardian Arena III Regional Qualifier at Vandenberg Space Force Base, Calif., Aug. 8, 2025. From shuttle runs and overhead presses to problem-solving, competitors faced six events testing physical endurance and mental agility. The top performers will earn their spot at the third annual Guardian Arena competition, Dec. 8–9 at Patrick SFB, Fla., going head-to-head with 35 of the best teams in the Space Force. (U.S. Space Force photo by Tech. Sgt. Luke Kitterman)
